ud4.1:23.2: Following variant _anuggatā_. Udānavarga here has _samudgatāṁ_ (“arisen”), which makes for an easier reading.
ud4.1:23.4: The idiom _hurā huraṁ_ is literally “from here to there”. It is explained by the commentary as meaning both from one sense stimulus to the other, and from one life to the next.
